# Owner tasks

- Deployment and domain configuration are intentionally left to the owner.
- Check printing on a physical Letter/A4 printer and touch interactions on a real classroom device.
- Produce the full launch video with audio if desired.

- Confirm printing on real Letter/A4 printers, including margins and optional OpenDyslexic text.
- Smoke-test Safari, Firefox and Edge. The automated acceptance browser is Chromium; fresh MDN reference retrieval was blocked here.
- Test multi-file downloads and PDF printing on real iOS/Safari devices; use the downloaded PDF viewer when automatic printing is restricted.
- Host the generated screenshots and hero loops if you want them embedded in the public GitHub README. Launch media is deliberately untracked.
- Unicode generation is broader than the bundled print fonts. Additional scripts need appropriately licensed fonts and glyph/shaping tests before promising printable coverage.
